title: rootless preexec: heap overflow in get_cmd_line_args when /proc/self/cmdline lacks the trailing NUL

comments.body:
Please follow our normal bug templates.

Generally speaking I do not see why we would care about outdated non mainline kernel versions upstream. If the kernel is broken that needs to be fixed there. We depend on newer 5.X kernel features anyway (i.e. new mount api) so I do not think there is any point in adding work arounds for such old kernel

cc @giuseppe
the kernel is old and can't really be used to run containers, but maybe it can still be useful to pull images there?  If such a fix (just add a NUL) is proposed as a PR, I'd not mind considering it.
